pages.name: Drowner
pages.text: Утопец — Drowner. A corpse granted a second, hungry life by the water.

pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: Rivers, frozen rivers, swamps and mangrove swamps. Spawns in water at low light.

pages.title: Behavior
pages.text: Pursues players and attacks at close range. Moves well in water.

pages.title: Weaknesses
pages.text: Necrophage elixir and oil increase damage against drowners.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: Drowner essence, claw and trophy head.

pages.title: Hunter’s advice
pages.text: Distance is easier to manage on shore. Avoid fighting in deep water.
